from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(df1, df2, column1="feature1", column2="feature2"):
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd

    left = df1.copy().rename(columns={column1: "__feature1__"})
    right = df2.copy().rename(columns={column2: "__feature2__"})

    common_cols = [
        c for c in left.columns
        if c in right.columns and c not in {"__feature1__", "__feature2__"}
    ]

    if common_cols:
        merged = pd.merge(left, right, on=common_cols, how="inner")
    else:
        left_key = next((c for c in left.columns if c != "__feature1__"), left.columns[0])
        right_key = next((c for c in right.columns if c != "__feature2__"), right.columns[0])
        merged = pd.merge(left, right, left_on=left_key, right_on=right_key, how="inner")

    merged = merged.dropna(subset=["__feature1__", "__feature2__"])

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()

    if merged.empty:
        ax.set_xlabel(column1)
        ax.set_ylabel(column2)
        return np.asarray([], dtype=np.int32), ax

    X = merged[["__feature1__", "__feature2__"]].to_numpy()
    kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=2, n_init=10)
    labels = kmeans.fit_predict(X).astype(np.int32, copy=False)

    sc = ax.scatter(
        merged["__feature1__"],
        merged["__feature2__"],
        c=labels,
        cmap="viridis",
    )
    ax.set_xlabel(column1)
    ax.set_ylabel(column2)
    ax.set_title("KMeans Clustering")
    fig.colorbar(sc, ax=ax, label="Cluster")

    return labels, ax
